items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Billy Papke in prose, stating 'The Paradise Club used to have bands, and the former boxer, a middleweight boxer called Papke, Billy Papke -- he used to have a nightclub.' The interviewee does not mention Billy Papke in their spoken response.

ctx.x: But that's a club that you might not have heard of.

The Paradise Club used to have bands, and the former boxer, a middleweight boxer called Papke, Billy Papke -- he used to have a nightclub. There were just so many clubs that they had, you know, around, and it's amazing that, as you say, that people didn't realize how much music was going on in Los Angeles.

So anyway, oh yeah -- I was gonna tell you about Lionel. Well, Lionel wanted the trio -- wanted Nat's trio and me; that was gonna be the nucleus, you know. And Nat and them were so close that they really wanted to go, but on my trip to New York that year ... I met and heard the trio that was the talk of New York; it was called the Clarence Profit Trio. Did you know of Clarence Profit Trio? There was a Clarence Profit Trio in New York, and all New York was raving about them, and I sat up and listened to them night…
